summary.en: Separate per-object state from class state and use static methods and initialization deliberately.
summary.bn: প্রতিটি অবজেক্টের ডেটা থেকে ক্লাসের যৌথ ডেটা আলাদা করে static ব্যবহার করো।

notes: This lesson uses Java 17 static initialization rules and no later language additions.

sections.title: Separate one class counter from many student records
Use static methods when no receiver is needed
Do not confuse shared with constant
The ownership rules stay the same
Share only what the model really shares

examples.title: Shared creation count, individual ids
examples.explanationHtml: The two objects hold ids 1 and 2. The single static counter records two constructions.

examples.title: One class initialization
examples.explanationHtml: The first active use initializes Settings and prints init once. Both method calls then read 30.

examples.title: A small utility class
examples.explanationHtml: The stateless operation needs no object. Its private constructor prevents callers from creating a meaningless utility instance.

examples.title: Static and instance initialization
examples.explanationHtml: The static block runs once. The instance block runs once for each of the two objects.

practice.title: Count constructed students
practice.statementHtml: Input: n from 0 to 20. Construct n Student objects and print Student.count().
hints: Increment the static field inside the constructor.

practice.title: Clamp through a utility
practice.statementHtml: Input: a mark from -100 to 200. Call a static utility clamp method and print the value within 0 through 100.
hints: Use the class name for the call.

practice.title: Last generated id
practice.statementHtml: Input: n from 0 to 20. Construct n Student objects and print the last id, or 0 when none exist.
hints: Keep the id in the instance and its generator in the class.

practice.title: Shared fee, separate credits
practice.statementHtml: Input: two credit counts from 0 to 30 and one fee rate from 0 to 10000. Set a shared static rate, construct two Enrollment objects, and print their bills separated by one space.
hints: Changing a shared rate affects both bills.

quiz.prompt: How many Student constructions does the static counter record?
quiz.explanation: Each constructor increments the same static field, so two constructions give 2.

quiz.prompt: How often does this static block print when a method is called twice?
quiz.explanation: Class initialization prints once, followed by one read line per method call.

quiz.prompt: Do separate ids retain the shared counter final value?
quiz.explanation: Each instance saves its own id at construction. The static counter does not replace those fields.

quiz.prompt: Which name best qualifies a static method call?
quiz.explanation: Class qualification makes the shared ownership clear and avoids misleading instance-style calls.

quiz.prompt: Why is this unavailable inside a static method?
options: Every static method runs before allocation
quiz.explanation: A static call belongs to the class rather than a current object.

quiz.prompt: Can a static method read an instance field through an explicit object reference?
options: Only if the field is also static
quiz.explanation: It needs a suitable object and legal access. It cannot use an unqualified instance field with no receiver.

quiz.prompt: When does ordinary static initialization occur?
options: Before the first relevant active use of that class
Only when the source is saved
quiz.explanation: Construction, static method calls and certain static field uses trigger initialization; compile-time constants are a special case.

quiz.prompt: What stops external construction of a utility class?
quiz.explanation: A private constructor makes new unavailable to outside callers.

quiz.prompt: What is a risk of a mutable static fee rate?
options: One change can affect unrelated instances
Every object gets an isolated copy
The value can never be changed
quiz.explanation: Shared mutable state creates dependencies among users of the class.

options: No; use final as well to prevent reassignment
quiz.explanation: static controls ownership; final controls reassignment. They address different concerns.

quiz.prompt: Does a static created counter automatically count only currently reachable objects?
options: Yes; static fields observe all live references
No; it records only the updates implemented by the program
quiz.explanation: A counter incremented in constructors measures constructions, not live objects.

quiz.prompt: Does reading a compile-time constant always initialize its declaring class?
options: Yes; every static field access does
Only if it is an int constant
No; the value may be inlined without class initialization
quiz.explanation: Compile-time constant uses are a special case to the ordinary active-use initialization rule.

keyPoints.en: A static field belongs to a loaded class rather than each instance.
keyPoints.bn: static ফিল্ড প্রতিটি ইনস্ট্যান্সের বদলে লোড হওয়া ক্লাসের হয়।

keyPoints.en: An instance field has separate storage in each object.
keyPoints.bn: ইনস্ট্যান্স ফিল্ডের জন্য প্রতিটি অবজেক্টে আলাদা জায়গা থাকে।

keyPoints.en: A static method has no current this reference.
keyPoints.bn: static মেথডে বর্তমান অবজেক্ট বোঝানোর this থাকে না।

keyPoints.en: Static initializers run in textual order when the class is initialized.
keyPoints.bn: ক্লাস ইনিশিয়ালাইজ হলে static initializer লেখার ক্রমে চলে।

keyPoints.en: A utility class can prevent construction with a private constructor.
keyPoints.bn: ইউটিলিটি ক্লাসে private কনস্ট্রাক্টর দিলে বাইরে থেকে অবজেক্ট বানানো আটকানো যায়।

keyPoints.en: Shared mutable static state requires care in larger designs.
keyPoints.bn: বড় ডিজাইনে যৌথ পরিবর্তনযোগ্য static ডেটা সাবধানে ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

examQuestions.question: Compare instance and static fields and methods in a Student model.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Each object holds its own roll or id. A static created count is shared by the loaded class. Instance methods have this; static methods do not. A static method can still use an explicit Student reference.

examQuestions.question: Trace one static block and one instance block when two objects are created.
examQuestions.answerHtml: The static block runs during the first class initialization. The instance block runs for the first object, then again for the second. The static block does not repeat.

examQuestions.question: When should a calculation be a static utility rather than an instance method?
examQuestions.answerHtml: Use a static utility when the result depends only on supplied inputs and no object identity or state is needed. Use an instance method when the calculation belongs to the receiver state.
